section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used to assess body mass index (self-reported height and weight), body dissatisfaction (Pulvers et al.'s culturally-relevant body size rating scale), body appreciation (Body Appreciation Scale or BAS), and body image flexibility (BI-AAQ). The section emphasizes the importance of using ethnically-relevant measures for diverse populations, particularly Black female participants, and provides psychometric evidence for each instrument's validity and reliability in the current study.
